issue_context.title: FRITZ!DECT 210 disable Switch-Button if in the Fritz Box the option is disabled to set  switch Manuel with the app
issue_context.body:

If in the web interface of the Fritz Box the option to switch the state with app is disabled, the switch of the [FRITZ!DECT 210](https://avm.de/produkte/smart-home/fritzdect-210/) should be also in Home Assistant disabled
